name: Castelo Branco
mandate: PrompTugal.news Castelo Branco: AI and technology in Castelo Branco, a Beira Baixa district capital whose centre of gravity is its polytechnic, now the Universidade Politécnica de Castelo Branco, and a small circle of local tech firms, and what reaches Castelo Branco from Portugal, Europe and the world. Independent. Every fact sourced.

gravity.text: Castelo Branco's AI activity sits around the polytechnic, which became the Universidade Politécnica de Castelo Branco on 1 August 2026, and the people it trains. Its health school runs AI in health days, two of its engineering professors founded the wildfire drone startup Axtron Systems, and a local waste-tech firm and an IT consultancy are the main private names. In 2026 the council itself began to speak about AI, opening the school year with an AI conference and saying it is weighing an AI academy, and it approved a drone and defence technology hub with a company called Odin Systems.

ai_news.title: Castelo Branco opens the school year with a conference on teaching in the age of AI
ai_news.summary: About 600 teachers and school heads met on 10 September 2026 for a session built around AI in education. The mayor said the council is considering an Academia IA, a course for young people and adults, and called for responsible digital literacy.
ai_news.ai_path: The council's own school-year opening was an event directly about AI, and it floats an AI academy.

ai_news.title: The council approves a drone and defence technology hub for Castelo Branco
ai_news.summary: A council meeting on 21 August 2026 approved an agreement with Odin Systems for an ODIN Defense Hub, described as linked to defence and technology such as drones and intelligent systems, an investment above 40 million euros with up to 120 jobs. It also approved a protocol with Beyond Vision to make drone components locally and test aircraft at the municipal aerodrome. The page gives no publication date, so the meeting date is used.
ai_news.ai_path: A planned hub whose products include drones and intelligent systems. The page does not say the systems use AI, so this is a hardware route towards AI.

ai_news.title: Castelo Branco's health school holds a day on AI in clinical practice
ai_news.summary: The health school of the polytechnic, ESALD, invited health professionals and students to a day of talks, a prompt engineering workshop and two round tables on using AI in daily care, its limits and its benefits. Projects from an AI in health micro-credential were presented.
ai_news.ai_path: A local university school runs an event directly about AI in healthcare.

ai_news.title: A Castelo Branco startup sends drones and AI to check fire breaks
ai_news.summary: Axtron Systems, founded in 2023 by two professors of the polytechnic's technology school, built FIRECOM. An AI model finds building outlines, sets the containment strips around them, and the drone images show where vegetation must be cleared. It came out of an EU Horizon Europe project.
ai_news.ai_path: A company based in the city ships a product whose core step is an AI model.

ai_news.title: Castelo Branco hosts a European meeting on social media and AI in disaster risk
ai_news.summary: The VOST Portugal association and the council organised two days in the city on using social networks and AI for prevention, preparation and response in disasters. Speakers from the emergency services saw value in algorithms for resource planning and raised questions about verification and privacy.
ai_news.ai_path: A meeting held in the city whose topic is AI in emergency management.

ai_news.title: IT consultancy Noesis opens a Castelo Branco office and says it will hire AI specialists too
ai_news.summary: Noesis opened offices in Guarda and Castelo Branco in February 2025 and plans about 30 hires, mainly in quality, DevOps, automation and low-code. It adds that it is open to data analytics and AI profiles across its regional expansion.
ai_news.ai_path: A tech employer opens in the city and names AI roles among those it wants: AI is a hiring interest, not the main business of the office.

ai_news.title: A Castelo Branco waste-tech firm plans a pilot with AI sensors for the council
ai_news.summary: Evox Technologies, founded in 2016 in the city, builds sensors and software for waste management. In an interview it mentioned a planned pilot with the Castelo Branco municipality that will use sensors with artificial intelligence. No other AI detail is given.
ai_news.ai_path: A local firm and the council plan a pilot with AI sensors, mentioned in passing in a business interview.

ai_map.name: Axtron Systems
ai_map.what: Startup based in Castelo Branco, founded in 2023 by two professors of the polytechnic, whose FIRECOM tool uses drones and an AI model to plan fire containment strips.
ai_map.ai_path: Its product runs an AI model on drone images.

ai_map.name: Universidade Politécnica de Castelo Branco (formerly IPCB)
ai_map.what: The polytechnic became a university on 1 August 2026, with six schools (five in Castelo Branco, one in Idanha-a-Nova). It hosts AI events and the startups that grow from its staff.
ai_map.ai_path: Its health school runs AI in health days and its professors founded an AI startup.

ai_map.name: Escola Superior de Saúde Dr. Lopes Dias (ESALD)
ai_map.what: The health school of the polytechnic, organiser of the AI in Health Days in January 2026 and of an AI in health micro-credential.
ai_map.ai_path: Teaches and hosts events directly about AI in healthcare.

ai_map.name: VOST Portugal
ai_map.what: Non-profit association based in Castelo Branco, organiser with the council of the March 2025 meeting on social media and AI in disaster risk.
ai_map.ai_path: Convenes events whose topic is AI in emergency management.

ai_map.name: Município de Castelo Branco
ai_map.what: The council co-organised the disaster risk meeting, opened the 2026 school year with an AI conference, says it is weighing an Academia IA, and is named as partner of a planned pilot with AI sensors.
ai_map.ai_path: Hosts AI events and plans an AI academy and an AI sensor pilot.

ai_map.name: Evox Technologies
ai_map.what: Waste-management technology company founded in 2016 in Castelo Branco, with sensors and software on its 360 Waste platform.
ai_map.ai_path: Mentions a planned pilot with AI sensors.

ai_map.name: Noesis
ai_map.what: IT consultancy with an office in Castelo Branco opened in February 2025, about 70 staff across Covilhã, Guarda and Castelo Branco.
ai_map.ai_path: Says it is open to hiring AI and data analytics specialists.

ai_map.name: Associação Ibérica de Turismo do Interior (AITI)
ai_map.what: Association that ran a certified course, AI Applied to Business, at the Castelo Branco municipal library with the Academia Digital do Turismo de Portugal and the council.
ai_map.ai_path: Ran a course directly about AI for business owners.

ai_map.name: Startup Castelo Branco (polytechnic incubator, PRR project)
ai_map.what: A science and technology based incubator initiative of the polytechnic, listed in the state's PRR transparency portal with a total of 150 thousand euros. The polytechnic's own page names it StartUp.CB and says it offers infrastructure, mentors, training and follow-up to technology-based startups.
ai_map.ai_path: An incubator for university spin-offs such as Axtron, which is an AI startup.

ai_map.name: Odin Systems (ODIN Defense Hub)
ai_map.what: Company with which the council approved in August 2026 a defence and technology hub (drones and intelligent systems), an investment above 40 million euros, up to 120 jobs, on municipal land outside the industrial zone.
ai_map.ai_path: Planned drones and intelligent systems, with no statement on AI itself.

ai_map.name: Zelar@CB (UPCB School of Technology project)
ai_map.what: Wearable and home power monitor that alerts carers about isolated elderly people, built by a team at the polytechnic and published as open code. Described in IEEE Spectrum on 28 August 2020.
ai_map.ai_path: It uses an AI algorithm trained on each user's normal electricity use to spot unusual days.

ai_map.name: Centro de Empresas Inovadoras (CEi), Castelo Branco
ai_map.what: The council's innovation centre, offering pre-incubation space, incubation services and business consulting. It also hosts a data centre, which the council and the police agreed in June 2026 to use for video surveillance backups, and houses Allbesmart, an IoT firm.
ai_map.ai_path: Hosts the startups and the data centre where AI work could run, but no page names an AI workload.

gaps: The council has no RSS feed and its news page has no date on article pages, so the August 2026 hub item is dated by the council meeting (21 August 2026). The news list runs to about 60 pages and only the titles and summaries were searched for AI terms.

Castelo Branco Digital (the council's online city platform) needs JavaScript and could not be read, so any AI or smart city service on it is unknown. The Cidade Inteligente page was read: it only describes Castelo Branco's role in the Portuguese smart cities network, with no AI.

The Odin Systems hub and the Beyond Vision drone protocol are known only from the council's own news item. A search found no independent report, no statement that the systems use AI, and nothing on Beyond Vision in Castelo Branco, so only Odin is on the map.
The council said it is considering an Academia IA. No follow-up page, date or budget was found.
A 2026 EU procurement notice for AI and process automation services appeared in a search, but the TED page returned nothing and the issuing public body could not be confirmed, so it is left out.

DeepNeuronic (computer vision, now part of Motorola Solutions per its own site) is placed in Castelo Branco only by a Spanish startup news piece from November 2022. Its own site names no town and its investor round included the University of Beira Interior, so it likely belongs on the Covilhã page. Left off the map until a source states its base.

Allbesmart (IoT for smart cities, a polytechnic spin-off at the CEi) and Axians (digital solutions, moving to a second CEi building) have pages that make no AI claim, so they are not on the map. The IPCB spin-off page and the firms' own sites should be read for AI work.

The CEi site and the CATAA centre's incubator pages were unreachable or gave no AI detail. CATAA lists projects such as DIGITOOL4AGRI and TID4AGRO, which could carry AI, but their pages were not opened.
The polytechnic has no feed and its news archive could not be paged, so older AI items on its site may be missing. The StartUp.CB regulation PDF and the list of incubated companies were not read.
The AITI business course on AI has no year on its page, so it is on the map but not in the news.
The FabLab is mentioned only in search snippets, so it is not on the map.
IBM's innovation centre is in Fundão, in the same district but outside the municipality, so it belongs on the Fundão page.
No AI investor, AI community meetup or investor fund based in the municipality was found. No local talent is listed because no public, consenting person was identified.

voice.lede: Castelo Branco: where the coverlets are embroidered by hand and the fire breaks are now checked by a drone with opinions, ai ai ai.
voice.mandate: PrompTugal.news Castelo Branco follows AI and technology in the Beira Baixa's capital, the city of the polytechnic that woke up one August as a proper university, and tells you what reaches it from Portugal, Europe and the world. Independent and sourced, pá.
voice.gravity: Here the action is at the university, meu amigo: a health school that runs AI days, two professors who made a wildfire drone startup, and a waste-tech firm and a consultancy for company. This year city hall woke up too: it opened the school year with an AI conference, is thinking of an Academia IA, and approved a drone and defence hub.
voice.gaps_intro: What we could not find, said with a shrug and a pastel de nata:

start_company.name: Council: InvestCB and the Investidor page
start_company.what: The council's investment strategy names five industrial axes, including information technology and aeronautics, and announced a Balcão do Investidor on its site. It lists an industrial incubator in the business location area.

start_company.name: Council: Balcão do Empreendedor (Espaço Empresa)
start_company.what: The council's page on the national electronic single counter for starting and running a business, with Licenciamento Zero explained.

start_company.name: CEi, Centro de Empresas Inovadoras
start_company.what: Council-run centre with pre-incubation space without forming a company, subsidised incubation services, business development support for R&D units and consultancy for startups and SMEs.

start_company.name: StartUp.CB, the polytechnic's incubator
start_company.what: Infrastructure, mentor networks, training and personalised follow-up for technology-based startups, with a published regulation and an information channel at the I9 office.

start_company.name: Boost@IPCB proof-of-concept contest (INOVC+)
start_company.what: Selected 4 research projects with 4,500 euros each, 18,000 euros in total, to move them to technology readiness levels 4 and 5. Open to staff, researchers and entrepreneurs of the polytechnic.

start_company.name: Poliempreende (22nd edition, 2026)
start_company.what: Polytechnic entrepreneurship contest with workshops on markets and business plans, a regional jury on 24 June 2026 and regional prizes of 2,000 and 1,500 euros.

start_company.name: I9@IPCB technology transfer office
start_company.what: The polytechnic's office for valuing research and moving it to business, under the INOVC+ project. Its spin-off page lists university spin-offs.

start_company.name: Empresa na Hora (national counter)
start_company.what: One-stop counter to form a limited company or similar in a single visit, with all partners present.

start_company.name: Startup Portugal
start_company.what: National startup agency site with a founder's guide, the national incubator network (RNi) and programmes.

investors.name: Portugal 2030 (Centro 2030) and the EU into INOVC+
investors.what: Co-funds the regional innovation ecosystem behind the polytechnic's I9 office and the Boost@IPCB contest, which pays 18,000 euros in prizes.
investors.ai_path: Funds technology transfer from the university, whose spin-offs include an AI startup: two steps.

investors.name: PRR into the polytechnic's incubator Startup Castelo Branco
investors.what: The state's recovery plan transparency portal lists the incubator initiative with a total of 150 thousand euros.
investors.ai_path: Backs the incubator for university spin-offs such as Axtron: two steps.

investors.name: Odin Systems, ODIN Defense Hub (private investment in the city)
investors.what: An investment announced by the council as above 40 million euros, to be built in phases, with a Potential National Interest (PIN) application planned.
investors.ai_path: Drones and intelligent systems, with no AI statement: two steps.
